title: Watermark map
description: Per-module watermark file. Maps source_id strings to watermark entries.

source_version.description: Last-extracted version. Cache-hit when this matches the current version.

n.description: Number of extractors spawned. Must be odd per D2.

majority.description: Number of extractors agreeing on final_verdict.

consecutive_empty_cycles.description: Per-source counter for exhaustion detection (used by US4 future logic).

recent_cycle_verdicts.description: Rolling window of the last 3 per-cycle verdicts (cache.py::append_cycle_verdict), oldest-to-newest. Added after this schema shipped (#295) — pipeline.source_bridge.cache.save_watermarks writes it via dataclasses.asdict on every entry, so it is present on every real watermarks.json.
